# webtables

> Backend truck: translates Packenger packages to WebAssembly, for WASI runtimes and browsers.

[source](../../registry/webtables.pkg) · truck

`webtables` is the third backend for the same front end:
`--target webtables` writes a WebAssembly text module, converts it with
`wat2wasm` and runs it with `wasmtime` (see
[toolchain](webtables/toolchain.md)). The output runs on any CPU and OS
with a WASI runtime, and in browsers.

```sh
packenger run examples/fib.pkg --target webtables
packenger build examples/fib.pkg --target webtables -o fib.wasm
wasmtime fib.wasm
packenger asm examples/fib.pkg --target webtables    # print the module
```

## Conventions

| what | how |
|---|---|
| every value | an `i64` on the WebAssembly operand stack |
| addresses | `i64` values, wrapped to `i32` for loads and stores |
| variables | in linear memory, because `&x` needs an address: a stack with frames like bintables', and a globals area |
| arguments | pushed on the memory stack right to left by the caller, popped by the callee |
| order of evaluation | the same as bintables |
| control flow | `block`, `loop` and `br`: structured, with the same labels |
| memory layout | strings, slices and structs as in every backend |
| operating system | Linux syscall numbers translated to WASI ([syscall](webtables/syscall.md)) |

## Memory map

| addresses | contents |
|---|---|
| 0–15 | unused, so that `null` is not a valid address of anything |
| 16–63 | scratch for WASI calls: I/O vectors, results, the clock |
| 64–95 | the buffer `print` converts numbers in |
| 128–279 | runtime messages and constants |
| 1024–1151 | scratch for file status |
| 4096–65535 | globals, 8 bytes each, in declaration order |
| 65536–8454143 | the stack (8 MB), growing down from 8454144 |
| 8454144– | the heap, growing up with `memory.grow` |

## Limits

- No processes: `fork`, `execve` and `wait4` have no WASI equivalent, so
  `rt/os`'s `os_run` returns an error, and `pkc` can't run here.
- Reading a directory (`getdents64`) and `getcwd` are not translated.
- Linear memory is 32-bit: at most 4 GB.
- Variables live in memory, not in WebAssembly locals, so the code is
  closer to bintables than to ctables in speed.

## Packages

| package | summary |
|---|---|
| [webtables/add](webtables/add.md) | Addition: `+`, with `i64.add`. |
| [webtables/addr](webtables/addr.md) | Address-of: `&x`, from the operand's `addr` section. |
| [webtables/alloc](webtables/alloc.md) | Helper: the heap. `$__pk_alloc(n)` returns `n` zeroed bytes, 8-aligned. |
| [webtables/and](webtables/and.md) | Logical and: `&&`, short-circuiting, with a typed `if`. |
| [webtables/argv](webtables/argv.md) | Command-line arguments: a `[str]`, built once from WASI `args_get`. |
| [webtables/as](webtables/as.md) | Conversion: `x as T`. To `u8` keeps the low byte, to `bool` tests for non-zero. |
| [webtables/assign](webtables/assign.md) | Assignment: to a variable, or through an address (fields, elements, `*p`). |
| [webtables/band](webtables/band.md) | Bitwise and: `&`, with `i64.and`. |
| [webtables/bor](webtables/bor.md) | Bitwise or: `\|`, with `i64.or`. |
| [webtables/break](webtables/break.md) | `break`: leaves the innermost loop's outer block. |
| [webtables/bxor](webtables/bxor.md) | Bitwise xor: `^`, with `i64.xor`. |
| [webtables/call](webtables/call.md) | Function call: the arguments are pushed on the memory stack right to left. |
| [webtables/const](webtables/const.md) | Constant declaration: nothing at run time; uses are replaced by the value. |
| [webtables/continue](webtables/continue.md) | `continue`: leaves the body block of the innermost loop, so its `next` block runs. |
| [webtables/cstr](webtables/cstr.md) | C string: the address of a string's bytes, which end with a 0. |
| [webtables/deref](webtables/deref.md) | Dereference: `*p`, a word or (for `u8`) a byte. |
| [webtables/div](webtables/div.md) | Division: `/`, rounding toward zero, with `i64.div_s`. |
| [webtables/do](webtables/do.md) | Block: `do ... end`. Scoping is resolved by the compiler, so it is just the body. |
| [webtables/dot](webtables/dot.md) | Field access: `p.f`, a load with the field's offset as the memory offset. |
| [webtables/eq](webtables/eq.md) | Equality: `==`, by value; strings by content. |
| [webtables/exprstmt](webtables/exprstmt.md) | Expression statement: evaluates the expression and drops the value. |
| [webtables/false](webtables/false.md) | `false`: the word 0. |
| [webtables/fn](webtables/fn.md) | Function definition: a WebAssembly function of no parameters returning an `i64`. |
| [webtables/ge](webtables/ge.md) | Greater than or equal: `>=`, with `i64.ge_s`, widened to a word. |
| [webtables/global](webtables/global.md) | Global variable: stores the initial value, if any, where it is declared. |
| [webtables/gt](webtables/gt.md) | Greater than: `>`, with `i64.gt_s`, widened to a word. |
| [webtables/if](webtables/if.md) | Conditional: `if`, `elif`, `else`, as nested blocks. |
| [webtables/index](webtables/index.md) | Indexing: `x[i]` on a `str` or a slice, with a bounds check. |
| [webtables/int](webtables/int.md) | Integer literal: an `i64.const`. |
| [webtables/le](webtables/le.md) | Less than or equal: `<=`, with `i64.le_s`, widened to a word. |
| [webtables/len](webtables/len.md) | Length: of a `str` (its first word) or a slice (the header's second word). |
| [webtables/let](webtables/let.md) | Variable declaration: stores the value at the variable's address. |
| [webtables/lt](webtables/lt.md) | Less than: `<`, with `i64.lt_s`, widened to a word. |
| [webtables/make](webtables/make.md) | Slice allocation: `make([T], n)`: a 24-byte header and `n` zeroed elements. |
| [webtables/mod](webtables/mod.md) | Remainder: `%`, with the sign of the left operand, with `i64.rem_s`. |
| [webtables/mul](webtables/mul.md) | Multiplication: `*`, with `i64.mul`. |
| [webtables/ne](webtables/ne.md) | Inequality: `!=`, by value; strings by content. |
| [webtables/neg](webtables/neg.md) | Negation: unary `-`, as `0 - x`. |
| [webtables/new](webtables/new.md) | Allocation: `new T`, a zeroed struct from `$__pk_alloc`. |
| [webtables/not](webtables/not.md) | Logical not: `!`. |
| [webtables/null](webtables/null.md) | `null`: the word 0. |
| [webtables/or](webtables/or.md) | Logical or: `\|\|`, short-circuiting, with a typed `if`. |
| [webtables/panic](webtables/panic.md) | Helper: runtime errors. Writes the message to stderr and exits with status 2. |
| [webtables/print](webtables/print.md) | Print: writes an `int`, `u8`, `bool` or `str` and a newline to stdout. |

| [webtables/shr](webtables/shr.md) | Arithmetic shift right: `>>`, the count taken modulo 64, with `i64.shr_s`. |
| [webtables/storage](webtables/storage.md) | Where variables live: a stack in linear memory, and a globals area. |
| [webtables/str](webtables/str.md) | String literal: a passive data segment, copied to the heap on first use. |
| [webtables/streq](webtables/streq.md) | Helper: string equality, `$__pk_streq(a, b)`: the lengths, then the bytes. |
| [webtables/sub](webtables/sub.md) | Subtraction: `-`, with `i64.sub`. |
| [webtables/syscall](webtables/syscall.md) | System call: Linux syscall numbers, translated to WASI. |
| [webtables/toolchain](webtables/toolchain.md) | How to build and run: `wat2wasm`, then a WASI runtime. |
| [webtables/true](webtables/true.md) | `true`: the word 1. |
| [webtables/var](webtables/var.md) | Variable read: a word loaded from the variable's address in linear memory. |

| [webtables/while](webtables/while.md) | Loop: `while cond ... [next ...] end`, as a `loop` inside a `block`. |
